title: OpenMeter technology reaches Kong Konnect
summary: Kong moved the OpenMeter acquisition into a Konnect product for AI cost control, chargeback, and monetization. This reduces integration risk, but uptake and financial impact remain undisclosed.
confirmed: Kong launched Konnect Metering & Billing following the OpenMeter acquisition.
The product targets AI cost controls, showback, chargeback, and usage-based monetization.
uncertain: Kong did not disclose product adoption, attach rates, pricing, bookings, revenue, or margin contribution.
